description: Ingest a document file (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD) into the vector database. Path must be absolute; re-ingesting the same path replaces its existing data. Returns { filePath, chunkCount, timestamp, fileTitle }.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the file to ingest. Example: "/Users/user/documents/manual.pdf"

visual.description: Run VLM captioning on figure pages (PDF only; default false).

visualQuality.description: VLM profile when visual is true (default "fast"). "quality" is more accurate on figures with in-image text but much heavier and slower. Ignored when visual is false.

name: ingest_file
